title: The micro-to-macro gap is smaller than the physical-to-conscious gap

statements.text: The gap between micro-level and macro-level consciousness is intuitively smaller than the gap between the non-conscious and the conscious. The same kinds of concepts, first-personal and qualitative, are used on both sides of the first gap, and a version of the knowledge argument is much less obvious there.

sources.quote: There is an intuitive sense in which the gap between macro-level consciousness and micro-level consciousness is smaller than the gap between consciousness and non-consciousness
the same kinds of concepts are employed on each side: first-personal, qualitative concepts
